title: Koshari
ingredients:
1 cup rice
1 cup brown lentils
1 cup macaroni
2 onions, sliced
400 g tomato sauce
1 tsp cumin
2 tbsp vinegar
method:
Cook lentils and rice together until tender.
Boil the macaroni.
Fry onions until dark and crisp.
Simmer tomato sauce with cumin and vinegar.
Layer rice, lentils and pasta, then top with sauce and onions.

title: Margherita Pizza
ingredients:
500 g flour
320 ml warm water
7 g yeast
200 g tomato passata
200 g mozzarella
Fresh basil
method:
Mix dough and let it rest for one hour.
Stretch the dough thinly.
Spread passata, add mozzarella.
Bake at the highest oven setting for 8 minutes.
Top with basil.

title: Chicken Curry
ingredients:
600 g chicken thigh
1 onion
3 garlic cloves
2 tbsp curry powder
400 ml coconut milk
Fresh coriander
method:
Marinate chicken in curry powder for 30 minutes.
Fry onion and garlic until soft.
Add chicken and brown it.
Pour in coconut milk and simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve with rice and coriander.

title: Greek Salad
ingredients:
4 tomatoes
1 cucumber
1 red onion
150 g feta
Handful of olives
3 tbsp olive oil
Oregano
method:
Chop vegetables into chunks.
Combine in a bowl with olives.
Top with feta, oil and oregano.

title: Fluffy Pancakes
ingredients:
200 g flour
2 tsp baking powder
1 egg
300 ml milk
Butter
Maple syrup
method:
Whisk dry ingredients, then add egg and milk.
Rest the batter for 10 minutes.
Cook ladlefuls in a buttered pan until bubbles form, then flip.
Stack with butter and syrup.

title: Tomato Soup
ingredients:
1 kg ripe tomatoes
1 onion
2 garlic cloves
500 ml vegetable stock
Basil
method:
Soften onion and garlic.
Add chopped tomatoes and stock.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth and season.
